name: integral-productivity-engineering
description: Engineering practice for Integral Productivity: routes cold-start of new repos to the right work-type template + scaffolding skill, then verifies the new repo classifies under devops-excellence's tier/work-type model. Bundles the work-type scaffolding skills (bootstrap-mcp-server, bootstrap-private-sdk) so the router can delegate in-plugin. Companion to the `devops-excellence` repo's bootstrap CLI and `template-*` repos.
